Growth

“I started as a Family Medicine resident in 2003 and stayed on as an Attending Physician because I wanted to give back to the hospital. Within two years, I also became program director of the residency program I graduated from!
In 2016, I was named Chair of Family Medicine and just last year, I was also given the title of Associate Chief Medical Officer. I stayed at TBHC because it’s like a community—everyone knows you, everyone is rooting for your success. There are still people on staff who remember me as a resident!”
--Sherly Abraham, MD, Associate CMO;
Chair, Family Medicine











Support

I started at TBHC in 2006 as a dietary helper. I then worked as a transporter for 13 years.  From these hands-on experience, I realized I wanted to go into nursing.  I went back to nursing school full-time for two years while I still worked and got so much support from  the hospital leadership. They accommodated my scheduling and encouraged me all the way. I also got a job as a nurse at TBHC when I graduated.  I love my job!"   
--Hakeem Salaam, RN









Teamwork

“I love my 18-year-and-counting career at TBHC, all in Radiology. I really enjoy the collaborative nature of my job. I work closely with physicians, techs and clerical staff to ensure all patients are happy. It’s just fun knowing that we are all pulling together on the same team.”
--Denise Famularo, Administrative Coordinator for Radiology 
 
Passion
